notes.title: Update 2.2
notes.content:
Vector's Adventures 2.2 update

- Vector formations are now automatic. Arrow formation triggers after moving for a set time and defense formation triggers when standing still.
- Arrow attack removed.
- The pen now continues to draw after hitting a wall or enemy.
- Monster Truck mini game score calculation is fixed.
- Closet doors physics removed when opening.
- Other minor fixes.
